_note: The start of a new game (Emilia, 2026-09-28): only home, the machine and collectibles (toys locked). You pull the capsule machine; on pull 'machine_pet_at' your first pet comes out of the machine itself and becomes your active pet. Then it's just you and the machine for a while, building it up (no guiding). Once you've fixed 'adventure_after' on the machine's tree (the next repair needs a bit, and bits come from adventures), the next capsule holds a second pet with a scribbled map: adventures open, and you send it on its first one. Steps: 'pull' (the lever's line, only until your first pull), 'machine' (no line), 'send'. Each step shows one line next to the thing to press ('go' instead while it points at the tab to get there first). 'speaker': 'machine' (a pet still inside the machine), 'active' (your active pet; {active} and {other} are filled in). 'box_talk' is what the pet inside a box says while you open one during the tutorial.

steps.speaker: machine
steps.say: psst… pull the lever towards you! something's rattling in here!

steps.speaker: active
steps.go: tap here to go on an adventure!
steps.say: a map! let's send {other} down the garden path! ♡

box_talk: it's dark in here! rip the top off! ♡
me too! let me out too!
